dialogue.origin: 入れておりますか？
dialogue.content: Am I connected?

dialogue.origin: ■本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: ■Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Thank you, I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.origin: ■それでは始めてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: ■Shall we begin then?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、相談員です。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。相談にあたり、年齢と性別を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Good evening, this is the counselor. Thank you for reaching out today. To begin, may I ask your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 17才、男ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: I'm 17, male. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 大学進学が不安で、、、
dialogue.content: I'm anxious about going to university...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。今年は例年とも違ってて、余計に分からないですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. This year is different from usual, which makes things even more uncertain, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 今は高校3年生ですか？
dialogue.content: Are you currently a third-year high school student?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、そのうえうちの学校で進学自体特殊で、、、
dialogue.content: Yes, and at my school, going on to higher education is unusual...

dialogue.origin: 今は２年です
dialogue.content: I'm a second-year now.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you for clarifying.

dialogue.origin: 進学自体が特殊とは？
dialogue.content: What do you mean by 'higher education being unusual'?

dialogue.origin: 工業高校なんで進学する人はほとんどいないんです
dialogue.content: It's a technical high school, so hardly anyone goes on to higher education.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか・・・少数派ということで学校としての蓄積も少ないのですね。
dialogue.content: I see... So you're in the minority, which means the school doesn't have much experience or resources for that.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです、、、
dialogue.content: That's right...

dialogue.origin: 学校では、おおまかにでも進路希望はもう出してあるのでしょ？
dialogue.content: Have you already submitted a general career path preference form at school?

dialogue.origin: 出してます
dialogue.content: Yes, I have.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。今の時点で、特にどんなところが不安に感じますか？
dialogue.content: I see. At this point, what specifically are you feeling anxious about?

dialogue.origin: 今まで勉強してこなかった上に、進路を大きく代えて進学にしたことが心配でしょうがないです就職の選択肢は今はないですし、、、
dialogue.content: I haven't really studied much until now, and I'm incredibly worried about making this big change to go to university. Getting a job isn't really an option for me right now...

dialogue.origin: 最初から大学進学と思っていなかたというところで不安が大きいのですね。
dialogue.content: So a lot of your anxiety comes from the fact that you hadn't originally planned on going to university.

dialogue.origin: 何か、進路変更したきっかけは？
dialogue.content: Was there something that prompted you to change course?

dialogue.origin: （最初から進学と思っていたら、もっと勉強していたのに…ですよね）
dialogue.content: (It's like, 'If I had planned on going to university from the start, I would have studied more,' right?)

dialogue.origin: 部活で怪我して、プロに行く目がなくなってしまい絶望のなかでの選択です
dialogue.content: I got injured in my club activity, lost my chance to go pro, and this was a decision I made out of despair.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか、怪我での断念は悔しかったですね。予想外のうえに、一番の希望ではなかった……。
dialogue.content: I see, it must have been devastating to have to give up because of an injury. It was unexpected and not your first choice...

dialogue.origin: もう人生終わりましたね、、、ここからはロスタイムです
dialogue.content: My life is over... From here on out, it's just injury time.

dialogue.origin: これまで、練習に打ち込んできて、ずっとプロを目標にしてっきたのですね。脱力感ですね。
dialogue.content: You've dedicated yourself to practice all this time, always aiming to go pro. You must feel completely drained.

dialogue.origin: してっきた　→　してきた　です。すみません。
dialogue.content: *Correction of a typo in the previous message.*

dialogue.origin: なので大学にいって再起を狙います
dialogue.content: So I'll go to university and aim for a comeback.

dialogue.origin: でも野球しかしてこなかったので勉強ができません
dialogue.content: But I've only played baseball, so I'm not good at studying.

dialogue.origin: 気持ちの切り替えがもうできているのですね。
dialogue.content: It sounds like you've already managed to shift your focus.

dialogue.origin: う〜ん、現実問題としての勉強がはだかるのですね。
dialogue.content: Hmm, so the practical problem of studying is standing in your way.

dialogue.origin: ところで、今の学校は、
dialogue.content: By the way, about your current school—

dialogue.origin: 正直これ以外思い付きません他にいい手段はありませんか？
dialogue.content: Honestly, I can't think of anything else. Is there any better option?

dialogue.origin: 大学進学でなければ、専門学校に進む、就職するなどあるかと思いますが、相談者さん（なんてお呼びすればいいですか？）は、大学進学の希望が強いのでは？
dialogue.content: If not university, there are options like vocational school or finding a job, but it seems that you (what should I call you?) have a strong desire to go to university, don't you?

dialogue.origin: ケイでいいです学校に行くことより野球を続けることが目的なんで、、、専門だと２年、大学なら４年の間に怪我を直して、復活する時間が欲しいところです
dialogue.content: You can call me Kei. My goal is to continue playing baseball, more so than just going to school. A vocational school is two years, but a university gives me four years. I need that time to heal from my injury and make a comeback.

dialogue.origin: ケイさん、ありがとうございます。大学からプロを目指したいのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you, Kei. So you want to aim for the pros from university.

dialogue.origin: はい、もうほぼなる予定でした
dialogue.content: Yes, I was almost set to make it.

dialogue.origin: それは、本当に惜しかった、悔しかったですね。
dialogue.content: That must have been so close, so frustrating.

dialogue.origin: はい、、、
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: すると……、まずは部活の顧問の先生にご相談されると良いかと思いますが、もうしてますか？
dialogue.content: In that case... I think it might be a good idea to talk to your club advisor first, but have you done that already?

dialogue.origin: 退部になりました怪我したヤツに居場所はないという具合です
dialogue.content: I was forced to quit the club. It's like there's no place for an injured guy.

dialogue.origin: そ、それは、ショックです。。。
dialogue.content: Th-that's... shocking.

dialogue.origin: 仕方のないことですよくあることなので
dialogue.content: It can't be helped; it happens a lot.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですか。厳しい現実なのですね。それでは、自力で大学に入ってリベンジしたいですね。
dialogue.content: Is that so? That's a harsh reality. In that case, you want to get into university on your own and make a comeback, don't you?

dialogue.origin: そうですねですが、その自力がないです
dialogue.content: That's right. But I don't have the ability to do it on my own.

dialogue.origin: ケイさんは、今、大学進学について不安を持っているけれども、大学進学の目的は野球でプロになるためですね。
dialogue.content: Kei, you're anxious about going to university right now, but your purpose for going is to become a pro baseball player, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: 今まで勉強してこなかったけれども、他の人の進学目的とは明らかに違いますね。
dialogue.content: Even though you haven't studied until now, your reason for going is clearly different from other people's.

dialogue.origin: ケイさんに合った方法で入学を果たせればいいですね。
dialogue.content: It would be great if we could find a way for you to get in that suits your situation.

dialogue.origin: そうですねやっぱり表舞台で活躍しないとそうですね、勉強しに行く気はないですただ卒業はしないとダメです
dialogue.content: That's right. I need to be in the spotlight. You're right, I don't intend to go there to study. But I do have to graduate.

dialogue.origin: とても難しいです
dialogue.content: It's very difficult.

dialogue.origin: いい方法はありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there a good method?

dialogue.origin: そうですね、入るだけでなく卒業もですね。方法を一緒に考えていきましょう。
dialogue.content: Right, not just getting in but also graduating. Let's think through the approach together.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします🙇‍♂️⤵️
dialogue.content: Thank you, I'm counting on you. 🙇‍♂️⤵️

dialogue.origin: はい。まず、ケイさんの場合は野球という目的があるので、野球が強いところ、ケイさんが入部できる大学でないとですよね。
dialogue.content: Of course. First, since your goal is baseball, it has to be a university with a strong baseball program, one that you can join, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね目ぼしいところは見つけてます
dialogue.content: That's right. I've already found a few promising places.

dialogue.origin: お、さすがですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, that's impressive.

dialogue.origin: 次は、何が気になりますか？
dialogue.content: What are you concerned about next?

dialogue.origin: 入れるかですね
dialogue.content: Whether I can get in.

dialogue.origin: そっか、そっか。確かに。
dialogue.content: Right, right. That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 今の高校は野球目的で工業高校に進んだと思うのですが、
dialogue.content: I imagine you went to a technical high school for the baseball program, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: まがりなりにもお金をかけて4年間、籍を置くのだから、
dialogue.content: Since you'll be paying for it and enrolled for four years, one way or another,

dialogue.origin: 多少なりとも興味の持てる学部・学科がいいですよね。
dialogue.content: it would be good to choose a department or faculty that you have at least some interest in, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: 興味ですか、、、
dialogue.content: Interest, huh...

dialogue.origin: 野球がメインだから、勉強は二の次でもいいかも知れない。でも、全く興味がない分野は、どうなのかな？
dialogue.content: Baseball is the main thing, so maybe studying can be secondary. But I wonder how it would be to study a field you have zero interest in.

dialogue.origin: 確かに
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: あとは、野球と両立できるかどうか？だから、実験で忙しいとかは無理ですよね。
dialogue.content: Also, can you balance it with baseball? So a major that keeps you busy with lab work, for example, would be impossible, right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね～
dialogue.content: Yeah, that's right...

dialogue.origin: そんな風に学部・学科を決めたら、入試制度にどんな制度があるか。。。
dialogue.content: Once you decide on a department and faculty like that, the next step is to see what kind of admission systems they have...

dialogue.origin: 工業高校なので工学部にしようと考えてます
dialogue.content: Since I'm at a technical high school, I'm thinking of going into engineering.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、それが一番自然な流れですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that seems like the most natural path.

dialogue.origin: ものを作るのは嫌いじゃないので
dialogue.content: I don't dislike making things.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: いいですね
dialogue.content: That's good.

dialogue.origin: そうしたら、積極的に担任の先生などに、アピールしていった方がいいと思います。
dialogue.content: In that case, I think you should be proactive in letting your homeroom teacher and others know about your plans.

dialogue.origin: なるほど
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 大学進学する人は少ないっていうことだけど、試しに何年か前の先輩で同じように野球目当てで受験した人とか、先生、知らないかなー。
dialogue.content: You said not many students go to university, but maybe you could ask if your teachers know of any upperclassmen from a few years ago who applied for similar reasons, for baseball.

dialogue.origin: 試しに聞くだけ聞いてみたら？
dialogue.content: Why not just try asking?

dialogue.origin: どうでしょか、、、かなり馬鹿げた進路選択なので、、、でも聴くのはタダですしね
dialogue.content: I wonder... it's a pretty ridiculous choice of path... but I guess it doesn't hurt to ask.

dialogue.origin: う〜ん、いないかもしれないけど、居たらいたで先生たちも覚えててくれてるかも。
dialogue.content: Hmm, there might not be anyone, but if there was, the teachers might remember them.

dialogue.origin: ですね
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 入りたいある程度大学は絞れているから、大学主催のオープンキャンパスを調べてみては？
dialogue.content: Since you've already narrowed down the universities you want to get into, why not look into their open campus events?

dialogue.origin: 大学選びはそれでいけそうですあとは入れるかどうか、、！
dialogue.content: That sounds like a good way to choose a university. The only thing left is whether I can get in...!

dialogue.origin: 入れるかどうかは、対策を立てないと。それには、大学のことをまず知らないとですよね。
dialogue.content: As for whether you can get in, you need a strategy. And for that, you first need to know about the university, right?

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 入試制度で、面接メインで受けられる制度とかあるんじゃないかな？
dialogue.content: In their admissions system, there might be an option where the interview is the main component, don't you think?

dialogue.origin: 一方で、勉強は勉強で今からでもやっておいた方がいいと思いますが。
dialogue.content: On the other hand, I do think it's a good idea to start studying now, just in case.

dialogue.origin: なるほど鉛筆持たなければ勝機はあるかもです!!
dialogue.content: I see—if I don't have to hold a pencil, I might have a chance!!

dialogue.origin: 勿論勉強もしますが
dialogue.content: Of course, I'll study too.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。最初から面接に期待しすぎても「こんなはずじゃなかった」となってしまいますね。とにかく、諦めず、調べるところからやりましょう。
dialogue.content: That's right. If you rely too much on the interview from the start, you might end up disappointed. In any case, let's not give up and start by doing some research.

dialogue.origin: わかりました、ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Understood, thank you.

dialogue.origin: ケイさんの、野球をやっていきたい気持ちがとても伝わってきいました。
dialogue.content: Kei, your passion for continuing baseball really came through.

dialogue.origin: 怪我は残念だったけど、
dialogue.content: The injury was unfortunate, but—

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今は、大学進学に目が向けられているから、あとは一つ一つやっていかれると、入りたい大学にも近づけている感覚も持てると思います。
dialogue.content: Now your focus is on getting into university. If you take things one step at a time, I think you'll start to feel like you're getting closer to the university you want to attend.

dialogue.origin: 何もしないと不安ばかりが先立つし、最初は何から手をつけていいいのか分からないかもしれないけど、
dialogue.content: If you do nothing, anxiety will just take over, and at first, you might not know where to begin, but...

dialogue.origin: こんな風に誰かに相談してみて、ケイさんは進んでいけるんだと思いましたよ。
dialogue.content: by talking to someone like this, I feel confident that you can move forward, Kei.

dialogue.origin: また、何かあったらご相談くださいね。
dialogue.content: Please feel free to reach out again if anything comes up.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますそうなれればと思いますはい、今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you. I hope so. Yes, thank you for today.

dialogue.origin: 本日の相談は、これで終了いたします。
dialogue.content: This concludes our session for today.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました(どうやら最初のはメッセージが通っていなかったようで、、、)
dialogue.content: Thank you (It seems my first message didn't go through...)

dialogue.origin: (二度めでマッチングできて良かったです)
dialogue.content: (I'm glad we could connect on the second try.)

dialogue.origin: ■お疲れ様でした。遅い時間まで、色々とありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: ■Thank you for your time today. I appreciate you talking with me, especially at this late hour.

dialogue.origin: (ありがとうございました)
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: ■お疲れ様でした。遅い時間までいろいろありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: ■Thank you again for your time. I appreciate your sharing so much with me, especially at this late hour.
